notes:
ほうれん{草|そう} is a nutritious vegetable commonly used in Japanese cooking.

COMMON DISHES:
- ほうれん{草|そう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{胡麻|ごま}→胡麻：10337_goma⟧⟦{和|あ}え→和える：05824_aeru⟧: spinach with sesame dressing
